# Collection Member Role

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CollectionMemberRole`](gmeow-CollectionMemberRole.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CollectionMemberRole>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

The role of a pitch within a collection — tonic/finalis, vādī, samvādī, ghammāz, ascent-only, descent-only, ornamental, or generic member. A value vocabulary of individuals; never subclassed ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

Use [`gmeow:CollectionMemberRole`](gmeow-CollectionMemberRole.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
